about: Office social accounts of each sitting NYC Council Member on Bluesky, Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn (#37). Curated by BetaNYC; not an official record. Office accounts only, never campaign or personal.
scope: The 51 people holding a Council seat on 2026-11-12. Joined on Legistar person_id.
method: Sources in order: the member's council.nyc.gov page ('Socials' links) = verified; listed in the Council's own Bluesky starter pack (@council.nyc.gov, re-read through the public Bluesky API on 2026-11-12) and not marked personal or campaign = verified (the pack also holds personal and campaign accounts, and blank profiles stay out, per BetaNYC's 2026-10-13 rule); otherwise the account's own bio naming the Council office or district = likely. Accounts that say candidate, campaign or personal, or link donations, are left out and explained in notes. null = none found. Several Threads profiles could not be read without logging in; see notes.
